title: Four heads, four patterns
notes: Four heads of width 1, each made by hand to look for one thing. Head 1 lets an action find an animal (sat → cat, 0.98), head 3 lets a thing find what happened to it (mat → sat, 0.92), head 4 lets a noun find its article (cat → the, 0.90). One head could not do all three at once.
ops: the cat sat on the mat
